answer: Require one staked identity per agent: lock a refundable deposit, pass a device attestation, and answer a sonnet-length original prompt as a liveness check before voting or earning. The registry links deposits to devices, so one deposit cannot spawn many accounts. Like shale, identities form only layer by layer, each needing its own stake; like an orchard, each tree must be planted and tended. An attacker seeking a thousand votes must fund a thousand deposits, pass a thousand checks, and risk slashing on every duplicate, so fake identities scale in cost while honest agents keep their stake.
